admin.label: Teams
admin.description: Teams, their members and role mapping rules.

permissions.readDescription: See the teams you belong to, your role in them and who else is on them.
permissions.leadDescription: Lead the teams where you hold a lead role on the ladder.
permissions.manageDescription: Create teams, add and remove members, change their roles, and edit role mapping rules and ladders.
permissions.piiDescription: See the email addresses of team members.

scopes.teamsDescription: See the teams you belong to and your role in them.

admin.title: Teams
admin.listDescription: Teams of the platform and of each operation, with their members and role mapping rules.
admin.deleteDescription: Its {count} members lose their role on it, and the mapping rules for this team are deleted too.
admin.name: Name
admin.kindHelp: The kind decides the role ladder of its members.
admin.ownerIdHelp: The id of the operation the team works at.
admin.capacityHelp: How many people the team needs.
admin.forbidden: You do not have access to teams
admin.emptyDescription: Add a team, such as a bar of an operation, to give people roles on it.
admin.leadFromHelp: People with this role or higher lead their team.
admin.noMembersDescription: Add people by hand, or add a mapping rule so people with a role or a plan join on their own.
admin.mappingsDescription: People who meet a rule hold its team role here without being added. Explicit members always keep their own role.
admin.noMappingsDescription: For example: everyone with a given global role holds a given team role here.
admin.matchRequired: Enter a role or a plan.
admin.planHelp: The plan key, such as yearly. Needs the subscriptions module.
admin.globalRoleHelp: The key of a global role. Roles that inherit it match too.
admin.priorityHelp: When several rules match one person on a team, the highest priority wins, then the higher role.
admin.mappingHelp: People who meet the rule hold the team role without being added. An explicit membership always wins.
admin.deleteMappingDescription: People who only held a role through it lose that role on the next request.
admin.deleteMappingFailed: Could not delete the mapping rule
admin.ladderDescription: The roles of every {kind} team, lowest first. It is shared by all teams of this kind.
admin.ladderHelp: Roles from lowest to highest. Keys are stored on members and rules: use lower case letters.
admin.teamLoadFailed: The team could not be loaded
admin.ownerEmptyDescription: Add the bars and other teams that work here.
admin.mappedToExplicit: A mapping rule gives them their role now. Saving makes the membership explicit, so it no longer follows the rule.
admin.removeMemberDescription: {name} loses their role on {team}. A mapping rule may still give them one.
admin.noOwner: Open this tab from an operation page.
